_comment: Labeled calibration set for the System One classifier. Each case names a fixture file, the 1-based line of the matched construct, the rule it belongs to, and the expected is_issue label. Consumed by the ignored live A/B test slopguard-ai/tests/calibration.rs.

ai-safety-comment-validation.rule_context: A // SAFETY: comment must state the concrete invariants and preconditions that make this unsafe block sound, not a generic 'this is safe because we checked'.

ai-doc-comment-quality.rule_context: A doc-comment on a pub fn or pub struct should add information the reader cannot get from the name and signature: preconditions, errors, panics, or non-obvious behavior.
